scenario: 一个 CTR 模型离线 AUC 很高,但输出的 P(click) 系统性偏高,广告竞价按 bid=P(click)×价值出价后开始悄悄超支。
scenario_en: A CTR model has high offline AUC but systematically overestimates P(click), and ad bidding at bid=P(click)×value quietly overspends.
q: 为什么损失函数选择要当成生产设计决策,而非纯理论?
q_en: Why treat loss-function choice as a production design decision, not pure theory?
why: 因为损失直接决定输出的性质:一个只最大化 AUC 但概率不校准的模型,会在二价拍卖里扭曲出价、悄悄流失营收。分类/排序/校准三类损失各服务不同下游需求,选错就算离线指标好看线上照样亏钱。
why_en: Loss shapes the output's usable property: an AUC-maximizing but miscalibrated model distorts second-price auction bids and silently loses revenue, so classification/ranking/calibration losses serve different downstream needs.
diagram:
flowchart TD L["损失函数选择"] --> C["分类损失
CE/Focal"] L --> R["排序损失
BPR/Lambda*"] L --> K["校准
Platt/Isotonic"]
options: 损失函数只影响训练收敛速度,不影响业务结果,随便选
损失决定输出性质:只追 AUC 但概率不校准会扭曲拍卖出价、流失营收,选错线上会亏钱
只要模型够大,任何损失都收敛到同样结果,选择无关紧要
损失函数是学术概念,生产系统统一用 MSE 即可
options_en: Loss only affects training convergence speed, not business outcomes, so pick any.
Loss decides the output's property: chasing AUC without calibration distorts auction bids and loses revenue, so wrong choices cost money in production.
With a big enough model, any loss converges to the same result, so choice is irrelevant.
Loss is academic; production uses MSE uniformly.
whenOtherWins: 若下游只需相对排序、完全不用概率绝对值(如纯召回排序),那对概率校准的要求可以放松,选排序损失即可。
optionExplanations: 损失直接决定输出是否可当概率用,"只影响收敛"低估了它的业务影响。
对;AUC 高不等于概率可用,校准差会在竞价/阈值这些下游悄悄亏钱,这就是它是设计决策的原因。
不同损失优化不同目标(排序 vs 概率),再大模型也收敛到不同性质的输出。
MSE 对分类和排序都不合适,统一用它会牺牲概率语义和排序质量。
optionExplanations_en: Loss decides whether the output is usable as a probability; 'only affects convergence' underrates its business impact.
Correct — high AUC doesn't mean usable probabilities, and poor calibration silently loses money downstream, which is why it's a design decision.
Different losses optimize different goals (ranking vs probability), so even big models converge to differently-shaped outputs.
MSE suits neither classification nor ranking; using it uniformly sacrifices probability semantics and ranking quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量模型排序能力(正样本排在负样本前的概率),但不反映概率是否校准。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures ranking ability (probability a positive outranks a negative) but not whether probabilities are calibrated.

termDefinitions.meaning: 赢家按第二高出价付费的拍卖机制,广告竞价常用,出价依赖校准的 P(click)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A second-price auction charges the winner the second-highest bid, common in ad auctions, where bids rely on calibrated P(click).

scenario: CTR 预估 head 要一个默认分类损失,类别大致均衡,下游还想直接用输出概率。
scenario_en: A CTR head needs a default classification loss with roughly balanced classes, and downstream wants to use the output probability directly.
q: 二元交叉熵默认好在哪,什么条件下输出接近校准?
q_en: Why is binary cross-entropy the default, and when is its output near-calibrated?
why: 二元交叉熵 L=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)],向真实标签方向给平滑梯度,是 CTR head 和二/多分类的工业标准。当类别大致均衡时,它的输出近似校准的后验概率,可直接用于下游竞价/阈值。
why_en: Binary cross-entropy gives smooth gradients toward the true label and, when classes are roughly balanced, yields approximately calibrated posterior probabilities.
options: 它专为极端不均衡设计,类别越偏越校准
它给平滑梯度、是工业标准;类别大致均衡时输出近似校准的后验概率
它只优化排序,不产出可用概率
它输出的分数没有概率意义,必须再套一层校准才能用
options_en: It's designed for extreme imbalance; the more skewed the classes, the better calibrated.
It gives smooth gradients and is the industry standard; with roughly balanced classes it yields approximately calibrated posterior probabilities.
It only optimizes ranking and produces no usable probability.
Its scores have no probability meaning and always need a calibration layer to be usable.
optionExplanations: 恰恰相反:极端不均衡下简单 CE 会被易负样本主导,那时才需要 focal loss。
对;平滑梯度+均衡时近似校准,是它当 CTR 默认损失的原因。
CE 是分类概率损失不是排序损失,它就产出概率。
均衡数据上 CE 输出本就近似校准,不是必须再套校准层。
optionExplanations_en: The opposite: under extreme imbalance plain CE is dominated by easy negatives, which is when focal loss is needed.
Correct — smooth gradients plus near-calibration when balanced is why it's the default CTR loss.
CE is a classification probability loss, not a ranking loss; it does produce probabilities.
On balanced data CE output is already near-calibrated, so a calibration layer isn't always required.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分类默认损失 L=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)],向真实标签给平滑梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Binary cross-entropy is the default classification loss, giving smooth gradients toward the true label.

termDefinitions.term: calibrated posterior / 校准后验概率
termDefinitions.meaning: 输出概率与真实发生频率一致(说 0.3 就约 30% 发生)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A calibrated posterior means predicted probabilities match real frequencies (0.3 means about 30% happen).

scenario: 欺诈检测正样本占比 <1/10,000,用普通交叉熵训练时海量易分负样本主导了梯度,模型学不到稀有正类。
scenario_en: Fraud positives are <1 in 10,000, and with plain cross-entropy the flood of easy negatives dominates the gradient so the model can't learn the rare positives.
q: 极端类别不均衡下该换什么损失?
q_en: Under extreme class imbalance, which loss should you switch to?
why: 用 focal loss:它加一个调制因子 (1−p_t)^γ,把已高置信分对的样本(p_t→1)的梯度压下去,让模型把注意力放到难分的稀有正类上。普通 CE 在 <1/10,000 这种不均衡下会被易负样本淹没。
why_en: Use focal loss: its modulating factor down-weights easy, high-confidence examples so the model focuses on hard rare positives, which plain CE drowns out under extreme imbalance.
options: 继续用普通 CE,再把学习率调大就能学到正类
focal loss:加调制因子 (1−p_t)^γ 压低易分样本梯度,聚焦难分的稀有正类
改用 MSE 回归标签,回归对不均衡更鲁棒
把所有负样本直接删到和正样本一样多,信息损失不重要
options_en: Stay with plain CE and just raise the learning rate to learn the positives.
Focal loss: add a modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma that down-weights easy examples and focuses on hard rare positives.
Switch to MSE on the labels; regression is more robust to imbalance.
Delete negatives down to the positive count; the information loss doesn't matter.
whenOtherWins: 当类别大致均衡、无需压易样本时,普通交叉熵反而更简单、开箱校准更好,不必上 focal loss。
optionExplanations: 调大 lr 不改变易负样本主导梯度的结构,稀有正类照样被淹没。
对;调制因子静默易分样本梯度,把学习信号集中到难分稀有正类,正是极端不均衡的解。
MSE 不是分类概率损失,对不均衡分类既不校准也不聚焦难例。
粗暴删负样本丢大量信息且不是损失层面的解,focal 才是在损失里重加权。
optionExplanations_en: Raising LR doesn't change easy negatives dominating the gradient; rare positives stay drowned out.
Correct — the modulating factor silences easy-example gradients and concentrates learning on hard rare positives, the fix for extreme imbalance.
MSE isn't a classification probability loss; it neither calibrates nor focuses on hard cases under imbalance.
Bluntly deleting negatives loses information and isn't a loss-level fix, whereas focal reweights within the loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在交叉熵上乘调制因子 (1−p_t)^γ,压低易分样本、聚焦难分样本,治极端不均衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Focal loss multiplies cross-entropy by (1-p_t)^gamma to down-weight easy examples and focus on hard ones, for extreme imbalance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型已高置信判为负的样本,在不均衡下数量巨大会主导梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Easy negatives are samples confidently classified as negative; under imbalance their sheer number dominates the gradient.

scenario: 面试官问 focal loss 里 (1−p_t)^γ 这个调制因子具体在干什么。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what focal loss's modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma actually does.
q: focal loss 的调制因子如何改变各样本的梯度?
q_en: How does focal loss's modulating factor change per-example gradients?
why: L_focal=−α_t·(1−p_t)^γ·log(p_t)。对已分对的高置信样本 p_t→1,(1−p_t)^γ→0,梯度被静默;对难分样本 p_t 小,因子接近 1,梯度基本保留。于是学习信号自动从易样本转移到难样本。
why_en: For confident correct examples (p_t to 1) the factor (1-p_t)^gamma goes to 0 and silences the gradient, while hard examples keep near-full gradient, shifting learning to hard cases.
options: 它放大所有样本的梯度,让训练更快
对高置信分对样本(p_t→1)静默梯度,对难分样本保留梯度,学习信号转向难例
它只作用于负样本,对正样本没有任何影响
它把梯度全部置零,相当于停止训练
options_en: It amplifies every example's gradient to train faster.
It silences gradients for confident correct examples (p_t to 1) and keeps them for hard examples, shifting learning to hard cases.
It only affects negatives and has no effect on positives.
It zeros all gradients, effectively stopping training.
optionExplanations: 它不是放大所有梯度,而是选择性压低易样本梯度,方向相反。
对;(1−p_t)^γ 随置信度增大趋零,把梯度预算从易样本挪给难样本。
它对任何已高置信分对的样本(含正类)都压梯度,不只负样本。
只有 p_t→1 的样本梯度趋零,难样本梯度保留,训练照常进行。
optionExplanations_en: It doesn't amplify all gradients; it selectively down-weights easy examples — the opposite.
Correct — (1-p_t)^gamma goes to zero as confidence rises, reallocating gradient budget from easy to hard examples.
It down-weights any confidently correct example including positives, not just negatives.
Only p_t-to-1 examples have gradients near zero; hard examples keep theirs, so training continues.

termDefinitions.meaning: focal loss 里的 (1−p_t)^γ,随预测置信度升高而减小,压低易样本贡献。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The modulating factor (1-p_t)^gamma in focal loss shrinks as prediction confidence rises, down-weighting easy examples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型对真实类别赋予的概率,p_t→1 表示已高置信分对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: p_t is the probability the model assigns to the true class; p_t near 1 means a confident correct prediction.

scenario: RetinaNet 默认 γ=2;一个 p_t=0.9 的样本损失被压到约原来的 1/100;γ 一般在验证集上调在 1–5。
scenario_en: RetinaNet defaults to gamma=2; an example at p_t=0.9 has its loss cut ~100x; gamma is tuned in 1-5 on validation.
q: focal loss 的 γ 该怎么理解和调?
q_en: How should you understand and tune focal loss's gamma?
why: γ 控压制强度:γ=0 退化成普通 CE;γ=2(RetinaNet 默认)时 p_t=0.9 的样本损失约降 100 倍。在验证集上 1–5 之间调,权衡稀有正类召回 vs 多数类精度;太大会连易样本都欠拟合。这是经验超参不是公式常量。
why_en: Gamma sets suppression strength: gamma=0 is plain CE, gamma=2 cuts a p_t=0.9 example's loss ~100x, tuned in 1-5 to trade rare-positive recall against majority precision.
options: γ 是学习率,越大训练越快
γ 控压制强度:γ=0 即 CE,γ=2 时 p_t=0.9 损失约降 100 倍,验证集 1–5 调,太大欠拟合易样本
γ 是类别数量,固定等于正负两类
γ 越大一定越准,应尽量设到最大
options_en: Gamma is the learning rate; larger trains faster.
Gamma sets suppression strength: gamma=0 is CE, gamma=2 cuts a p_t=0.9 loss ~100x, tuned 1-5 on validation, too high underfits easy examples.
Gamma is the number of classes, fixed at two for positive/negative.
Larger gamma is always more accurate, so set it as high as possible.
optionExplanations: γ 不是学习率,它只调易样本的压制强度,与步长无关。
对;γ 是压制旋钮,γ=0 退回 CE、γ=2 是常用默认,过大反而欠拟合易样本,得验证集上调。
γ 与类别数无关,它是控制调制因子陡峭度的连续超参。
γ 太大会把易样本梯度也压没导致欠拟合,不是越大越好。
optionExplanations_en: Gamma isn't the learning rate; it only sets easy-example suppression, unrelated to step size.
Correct — gamma is the suppression knob: gamma=0 reverts to CE, gamma=2 is a common default, and too high underfits easy examples, so tune on validation.
Gamma is unrelated to class count; it's a continuous hyperparameter controlling the modulating factor's steepness.
Too-high gamma suppresses easy-example gradients into underfitting, so bigger isn't always better.

termDefinitions.meaning: focal loss 里控制易样本压制强度的超参,γ=0 即普通 CE。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Gamma is focal loss's focusing hyperparameter controlling easy-example suppression; gamma=0 is plain cross-entropy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 提出 focal loss 的稠密目标检测模型,默认 γ=2。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RetinaNet is the dense object-detection model that introduced focal loss, defaulting to gamma=2.

scenario: 有人以为上了 focal loss 就不必再管数据采样了。
scenario_en: Someone assumes adopting focal loss removes any need for data sampling.
q: focal loss 能替代过采样/类别加权采样吗?
q_en: Does focal loss replace oversampling / class-weighted sampling?
why: 不能替代:focal 在损失层面重加权,过采样在数据层面平衡分布,两者互补。实践中把 focal loss 与分层小批(每个 batch 保证一定比例正样本)结合,效果最好;只靠 focal 而 batch 里几乎没有正样本,梯度依旧稀薄。
why_en: Focal loss reweights at the loss level while oversampling balances at the data level, so combine focal with stratified mini-batches rather than replacing sampling.
options: 能,focal loss 完全取代采样,数据侧不用再动
不能,focal 在损失层重加权、采样在数据层平衡,应与分层小批结合
能,只要 γ 够大就不需要任何采样
两者冲突,用了 focal 就绝不能再做任何采样
options_en: Yes, focal loss fully replaces sampling; the data side needs no change.
No — focal reweights at the loss level and sampling balances at the data level, so combine focal with stratified mini-batches.
Yes, as long as gamma is large enough no sampling is needed.
They conflict; using focal means never doing any sampling.
optionExplanations: focal 不平衡 batch 里的样本构成,若一个 batch 几乎全是负样本,梯度仍稀薄。
对;损失重加权与数据采样互补,分层小批+ focal 才能同时保证正样本出现和难例聚焦。
γ 再大也解决不了 batch 里正样本极少的问题,采样管的是分布不是权重。
两者不冲突而是互补,实践中常一起用。
optionExplanations_en: Focal doesn't balance batch composition; if a batch is almost all negatives, gradients stay thin.
Correct — loss reweighting and data sampling are complementary, so stratified mini-batches plus focal ensure both positive presence and hard-case focus.
No gamma fixes batches with almost no positives; sampling controls distribution, not weights.
They don't conflict but complement, and are commonly used together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 构造每个训练 batch 时保证各类别有一定比例,防某类在 batch 中缺席。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A stratified mini-batch is built to guarantee each class a share, preventing a class from being absent in the batch.

scenario: 小测:在 γ>0 的 focal loss 下,一个已经分得很好的样本(p_t→1)的梯度会怎样?
scenario_en: Quiz: under focal loss with gamma>0, what happens to the gradient of a well-classified example (p_t to 1)?
q: γ>0 时,已分好样本的梯度贡献如何变化?
q_en: With gamma>0, how does a well-classified example's gradient change?
why: 显著减小:(1−p_t)^γ 在 p_t→1 时趋近 0,把这些已学会样本的梯度几乎抹掉,好让优化器把力气花在还没学好的难样本上。这正是 focal loss 治不均衡的核心机制。
why_en: It is significantly reduced, because (1-p_t)^gamma approaches zero as p_t to 1, nearly erasing well-classified examples' gradients so the optimizer focuses on hard ones.
options: 显著增大,模型更用力去学已经会的样本
显著减小,(1−p_t)^γ→0 抹掉已学好样本的梯度,力气转向难样本
完全不变,与普通 CE 一样
先增大后减小,取决于 batch 大小
options_en: Significantly increased; the model works harder on already-learned examples.
Significantly reduced; (1-p_t)^gamma to 0 erases well-classified examples' gradients, shifting effort to hard ones.
Unchanged, same as plain CE.
First increases then decreases depending on batch size.
optionExplanations: 已学会的样本正是要压制的对象,不该增大它们的梯度。
对;调制因子在高置信处趋零,静默易样本、聚焦难样本,是 focal 的设计目的。
γ>0 时它明显不同于 CE,易样本梯度被压,不是不变。
变化只取决于 p_t 和 γ,和 batch 大小无关。
optionExplanations_en: Already-learned examples are exactly what to suppress; their gradients shouldn't grow.
Correct — the modulating factor nears zero at high confidence, silencing easy and focusing on hard examples, focal's design goal.
With gamma>0 it clearly differs from CE; easy-example gradients are suppressed, not unchanged.
The change depends only on p_t and gamma, not batch size.

scenario: 排序损失按"一次看多少数据"分成三类,面试官要你区分。
scenario_en: Ranking losses split by 'how much data at once' into three units; the interviewer asks you to distinguish them.
q: pointwise / pairwise / listwise 的区别是什么?
q_en: What distinguishes pointwise / pairwise / listwise?
why: pointwise 给每个物品一个绝对分,忽略它在列表中的相对位置;pairwise 只要求相关项排在不相关项之前(成对比较);listwise 直接优化整张列表的指标(如 NDCG)。粒度从单点→成对→整列,越靠后越贴近最终排序指标但计算越贵。
why_en: Pointwise scores each item absolutely, pairwise enforces relevant-over-irrelevant order, and listwise optimizes a whole-list metric like NDCG.
options: 三者完全一样,只是叫法不同
pointwise 单项绝对分;pairwise 成对相对序;listwise 优化整列表指标(如 NDCG)
pointwise 优化整列表、listwise 单项打分,和实际相反
三者都只看单个物品,不考虑列表
options_en: All three are the same, just different names.
Pointwise scores single items absolutely; pairwise enforces pairwise relative order; listwise optimizes a whole-list metric like NDCG.
Pointwise optimizes the whole list and listwise scores single items — reversed from reality.
All three look only at a single item, ignoring the list.
optionExplanations: 三者优化粒度不同(点/对/列),直接影响是否对齐最终排序指标,不是叫法差异。
对;从单点到成对到整列,粒度递增、越贴近 NDCG 但越贵,是排序损失的分类主轴。
角色说反了:pointwise 是单项打分,listwise 才优化整列表。
只有 pointwise 只看单项;pairwise 看成对、listwise 看整列表。
optionExplanations_en: They differ in granularity (point/pair/list), which affects alignment to the final ranking metric — not just naming.
Correct — from point to pair to list, granularity rises, closer to NDCG but costlier, the main axis of ranking losses.
Roles reversed: pointwise scores single items and listwise optimizes the whole list.
Only pointwise looks at a single item; pairwise looks at pairs and listwise at the whole list.

termDefinitions.meaning: 排序质量指标,越靠前的相关项贡献越大,越靠后折扣越多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a ranking-quality metric where relevant items higher up contribute more.

scenario: 推荐里只有隐式反馈(用户点了什么),没有显式评分,想训一个学相对偏好的模型。
scenario_en: A recommender has only implicit feedback (what users clicked), no explicit ratings, and wants to learn relative preference.
q: BPR 的优化目标和适用信号是什么?
q_en: What is BPR's objective and the feedback it suits?
why: BPR 是 pairwise:最大化"正样本 i 的分高于随机采样负样本 j"的概率,L_BPR=−log σ(x̂_ui−x̂_uj)。它只需正确的相对排序、不需绝对分,天然适配点击这类隐式反馈,靠负采样能扩到数十亿对,是候选生成的默认损失。
why_en: BPR is pairwise: it maximizes the probability a positive scores above a sampled negative, needing only correct ordering, so it suits implicit feedback and scales via negative sampling.
options: BPR 要求每个物品有精确的绝对评分,只能用显式反馈
BPR pairwise 最大化正样本分>采样负样本,只需相对序,适配隐式反馈,负采样可扩
BPR 直接优化 NDCG,是 listwise 损失
BPR 输出校准的点击概率,专为竞价设计
options_en: BPR requires an exact absolute rating per item, usable only with explicit feedback.
BPR is pairwise, maximizing positive-over-sampled-negative, needing only relative order, suited to implicit feedback, scalable via negative sampling.
BPR directly optimizes NDCG and is a listwise loss.
BPR outputs calibrated click probabilities, designed for bidding.
optionExplanations: BPR 恰恰不需要绝对评分,它只比较正负相对高低,专为无评分的隐式反馈设计。
对;pairwise 相对序+负采样让它便宜可扩,是候选生成阶段的默认损失。
BPR 是 pairwise 不是 listwise,它不直接优化 NDCG(那是 LambdaRank)。
BPR 优化排序不保证概率校准,竞价需要校准的概率损失而非 BPR。
optionExplanations_en: BPR specifically needs no absolute ratings; it compares positive vs negative order, built for rating-free implicit feedback.
Correct — pairwise relative order plus negative sampling make it cheap and scalable, the default candidate-generation loss.
BPR is pairwise not listwise; it doesn't directly optimize NDCG (that's LambdaRank).
BPR optimizes ranking without guaranteeing calibration; bidding needs a calibrated probability loss, not BPR.

termDefinitions.meaning: pairwise 排序损失,最大化正样本得分高于采样负样本,适配隐式反馈。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BPR (Bayesian Personalized Ranking) is a pairwise ranking loss maximizing a positive scoring above a sampled negative, for implicit feedback.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户行为(点击/购买)隐含的偏好信号,没有显式打分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Implicit feedback is preference inferred from behavior (clicks/purchases) with no explicit ratings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从海量未交互项里随机抽负样本与正样本配对,避免全量计算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative sampling randomly draws negatives from the vast un-interacted items to pair with positives, avoiding full computation.

scenario: 召回(candidate generation)阶段要从数十亿物品里快速筛出几百个候选,只需近似排序、追求速度和规模。
scenario_en: The candidate-generation stage must quickly narrow billions of items to a few hundred, needing only approximate ordering at speed and scale.
q: 召回阶段的排序损失该选什么?
q_en: Which ranking loss fits candidate generation?
why: 选 BPR:候选生成只需近似正确的相对序、要快要能扩,BPR 的 pairwise+负采样正好又快又能到数十亿对。精细的、按位置加权的 listwise(LambdaRank)留给最终重排,那里指标对齐更值这份算力。
why_en: Pick BPR: candidate generation needs fast, scalable approximate ordering, which pairwise-plus-negative-sampling delivers, leaving metric-aligned listwise for final re-ranking.
options: LambdaRank,直接优化 NDCG 最精确,召回也该用最好的
BPR,pairwise+负采样又快又可扩,近似排序满足召回的速度/规模需求
普通 MSE 回归,召回只要回归分数
focal loss,召回阶段最怕类别不均衡
options_en: LambdaRank — it optimizes NDCG most precisely, and recall deserves the best too.
BPR — pairwise plus negative sampling is fast and scalable, and approximate ordering meets recall's speed/scale needs.
Plain MSE regression — recall just needs regressed scores.
Focal loss — recall most fears class imbalance.
whenOtherWins: 到最终重排阶段,候选只剩几百个、指标对齐比速度更重要时,才换成 LambdaRank/LambdaMART。
optionExplanations: LambdaRank 逐位置加权算得贵,数十亿候选上跑不动,精度换不回召回要的吞吐。
对;BPR 便宜可扩、近似排序够用,是召回阶段的默认选择。
MSE 回归不直接优化排序,召回要的是相对序不是绝对回归值。
focal 是分类不均衡损失,不解决召回的大规模排序问题。
optionExplanations_en: LambdaRank's per-position weighting is costly and can't run over billions of candidates; precision doesn't buy back recall's needed throughput.
Correct — BPR is cheap, scalable, and approximate ordering suffices, the default at the recall stage.
MSE regression doesn't directly optimize ranking; recall needs relative order, not absolute regressed values.
Focal is a classification-imbalance loss, not a fix for recall's large-scale ranking.

scenario: 用 BPR 训练排序,发现它对"交换发生在列表哪个位置"一视同仁。
scenario_en: Training ranking with BPR, you notice it treats a swap the same regardless of where in the list it happens.
q: BPR 相比 listwise 的关键局限是什么?
q_en: What is BPR's key limitation versus listwise?
why: BPR 不加权"交换发生在列表哪里":把第 1、2 名交换和第 98、99 名交换视为同等,但对用户/指标而言头部错序代价远大。listwise(LambdaRank)正是用 NDCG 变化给不同位置的交换赋不同权重来补上这点。
why_en: BPR doesn't weight where a swap occurs, treating top-of-list and bottom swaps equally, whereas listwise weights by NDCG change.
options: BPR 无法处理隐式反馈,只能用显式评分
BPR 不加权交换位置:头部错序和尾部错序同等对待,忽略了位置的重要性差异
BPR 计算太贵,无法扩到大规模
BPR 会输出过度校准的概率,破坏排序
options_en: BPR can't handle implicit feedback and needs explicit ratings.
BPR doesn't weight swap position: it treats top and bottom mis-orderings equally, ignoring positional importance.
BPR is too expensive to scale.
BPR outputs over-calibrated probabilities that break ranking.
optionExplanations: BPR 正是为隐式反馈设计的,这说反了。
对;不区分交换位置是 BPR 的核心局限,头部排序质量因此得不到重点优化。
BPR 靠负采样恰恰便宜可扩,不是贵。
BPR 不优化概率校准,谈不上过度校准,和它的位置局限无关。
optionExplanations_en: BPR is designed for implicit feedback — this is reversed.
Correct — not distinguishing swap position is BPR's core limitation, so top-of-list quality isn't prioritized.
BPR is cheap and scalable via negative sampling, not expensive.
BPR doesn't optimize calibration, so over-calibration doesn't apply and is unrelated to its positional limitation.

scenario: 最终重排要让头部顺序尽量对,交换排名靠前的两个物品应该比交换靠后的更受重视。
scenario_en: Final re-ranking must get the head order right, so swapping two top items should matter more than swapping bottom ones.
q: LambdaRank 如何让排序对齐 NDCG?
q_en: How does LambdaRank align ranking with NDCG?
why: LambdaRank 给每对样本的 pairwise 梯度乘上"交换这两个位置带来的 NDCG 变化":交换 1↔2 对 NDCG 影响大、权重大,交换 98↔99 影响小、权重小。这样直接把优化力度对齐到最终排序指标,而无需对不可导的 NDCG 求导。
why_en: LambdaRank weights each pairwise gradient by the NDCG change from swapping those two positions, so top swaps get larger gradients aligned to the metric.
options: 它对所有位置的交换赋予相同权重,和 BPR 一样
它给每对梯度乘上交换这两位带来的 NDCG 变化,头部交换权重更大,对齐指标
它直接对 NDCG 求导来反向传播
它放弃排序,改成逐项概率回归
options_en: It gives all swap positions equal weight, just like BPR.
It multiplies each pairwise gradient by the NDCG change from swapping those two positions, so top swaps get larger weight aligned to the metric.
It directly differentiates NDCG for backprop.
It abandons ranking for per-item probability regression.
optionExplanations: 等权正是 BPR 的做法,LambdaRank 的价值恰恰是按位置差异化加权。
对;用 NDCG 变化加权每对梯度,让优化重点落在头部,是它对齐指标的核心。
NDCG 不可导,LambdaRank 正是绕开求导、直接用指标变化当梯度权重。
它仍是排序损失,只是给 pairwise 梯度加了指标权重,不是回归。
optionExplanations_en: Equal weighting is BPR's approach; LambdaRank's value is exactly position-differentiated weighting.
Correct — weighting each pairwise gradient by NDCG change concentrates optimization on the head, its metric-alignment core.
NDCG is non-differentiable; LambdaRank specifically sidesteps differentiation by using metric change as the gradient weight.
It remains a ranking loss, just adding a metric weight to pairwise gradients, not regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: listwise 排序,用交换两位带来的 NDCG 变化加权每对 pairwise 梯度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LambdaRank is a listwise method weighting each pairwise gradient by the NDCG change from swapping two positions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 这些经指标加权的梯度,无需对不可导的 NDCG 求导即可得到。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The lambdas are these metric-weighted gradients, obtained without differentiating the non-differentiable NDCG.

scenario: 特征丰富的搜索排序场景,想要 listwise 的指标对齐,又想用树模型的表达力。
scenario_en: A feature-rich search-ranking setting wants listwise metric alignment with the expressiveness of tree models.
q: LambdaMART 是怎么构成的,擅长什么?
q_en: How is LambdaMART built, and what is it good at?
why: LambdaMART = 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度放进 GBDT:每一轮 boosting 用一棵树去拟合这些指标加权的 lambda 梯度。它是 Bing 搜索排序的主力,在特征丰富的场景里与神经排序器不相上下。
why_en: LambdaMART puts LambdaRank's lambda gradients inside GBDT, fitting a tree to those metric-weighted gradients each boosting round, the backbone of Bing search ranking.
options: 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度塞进神经网络的注意力层
把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度放进 GBDT,每轮树拟合这些指标加权梯度;Bing 搜索排序主力
一种纯 pointwise 回归损失,与 NDCG 无关
只是 BPR 的另一个名字,机制完全相同
options_en: Put LambdaRank's lambda gradients into a neural attention layer.
Put LambdaRank's lambda gradients into GBDT, fitting a tree to those metric-weighted gradients each round; the backbone of Bing search ranking.
A pure pointwise regression loss unrelated to NDCG.
Just another name for BPR with identical mechanics.
optionExplanations: LambdaMART 用的是梯度提升树 GBDT 不是神经注意力,载体说错了。
对;λ 梯度 + GBDT 的组合,让树模型也能对齐 NDCG,在特征丰富场景很强。
它是 listwise 指标对齐的,不是与 NDCG 无关的 pointwise 回归。
它是 GBDT 载体的 listwise 方法,和 pairwise 的 BPR 机制不同。
optionExplanations_en: LambdaMART uses gradient-boosted trees (GBDT), not neural attention — wrong carrier.
Correct — lambda gradients plus GBDT let trees align to NDCG, strong in feature-rich settings.
It's listwise metric-aligned, not an NDCG-agnostic pointwise regression.
It's a GBDT-based listwise method, mechanically different from pairwise BPR.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LambdaRank 的 λ 梯度用在 GBDT 上的 listwise 排序方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LambdaMART is a listwise ranking method applying LambdaRank's lambda gradients within GBDT.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐轮加树、每棵拟合前一轮残差/梯度的树集成模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GBDT (Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees) is a tree ensemble adding trees round by round, each fitting the previous round's residual/gradient.

scenario: 最终重排阶段只剩几百个候选,要把头部顺序做到最精,直接对齐 NDCG 换取业务价值。
scenario_en: Final re-ranking has a few hundred candidates and must perfect the head order, aligning to NDCG for business value.
q: 最终重排该用哪类损失?
q_en: Which loss family for final re-ranking?
why: 用 LambdaMART/LambdaRank 这类 listwise:候选少、可承受更高算力,而它们按位置用 NDCG 加权梯度,把头部排序做精,指标对齐直接转成业务价值。BPR 只给近似序、不加权位置,精度不够。
why_en: Use listwise LambdaMART/LambdaRank: few candidates afford the compute, and NDCG-weighted gradients perfect the head order for business value.
options: BPR,pairwise 又快又能扩,重排也该优先速度
LambdaMART/LambdaRank(listwise),按位置 NDCG 加权把头部排序做精,指标对齐
focal loss,重排最怕不均衡
普通交叉熵逐项打分,忽略列表结构
options_en: BPR — pairwise is fast and scalable, and re-ranking should prioritize speed too.
LambdaMART/LambdaRank (listwise) — NDCG-weighted by position to perfect the head order, aligned to the metric.
Focal loss — re-ranking most fears imbalance.
Plain cross-entropy per-item scoring, ignoring list structure.
whenOtherWins: 在召回阶段、候选达数十亿、速度和规模压倒精度时,反而该用 BPR 而非 listwise。
optionExplanations: 重排阶段候选已很少,速度不再是瓶颈,BPR 的近似序换不来头部精度。
对;listwise 按位置加权对齐 NDCG,把头部做精,正是重排追求的价值。
focal 是分类不均衡损失,与重排的列表排序目标不符。
逐项 CE 忽略列表结构,得不到 listwise 的位置加权优势。
optionExplanations_en: At re-ranking candidates are already few and speed isn't the bottleneck, so BPR's approximate order doesn't buy head precision.
Correct — listwise weights by position to align with NDCG and perfect the head, exactly re-ranking's goal.
Focal is a classification-imbalance loss, mismatched to re-ranking's list-ordering objective.
Per-item CE ignores list structure and misses listwise's positional weighting advantage.

scenario: 面试官要你横向比较 CE、BPR、LambdaRank、LambdaMART 的方法和最佳用途。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks you to compare CE, BPR, LambdaRank, and LambdaMART by approach and best use.
q: 这四个损失的方法与最佳用途分别是什么?
q_en: What are each loss's approach and best use?
why: CE 是 pointwise 单项概率,做 CTR;BPR pairwise 正负边际,做候选生成(隐式反馈);LambdaRank listwise 用 NDCG 加权 pairwise 梯度,做最终重排;LambdaMART 把 λ 梯度放 GBDT,做大规模搜索排序。粒度和载体决定各自战场。
why_en: CE is pointwise for CTR, BPR pairwise for candidate generation, LambdaRank listwise for re-ranking, and LambdaMART lambda-gradients-in-GBDT for search ranking.
options: 四者用途完全可互换,选哪个都一样
CE→CTR;BPR→候选生成;LambdaRank→最终重排;LambdaMART→大规模搜索排序
CE 做重排、LambdaRank 做 CTR,和实际相反
四者都是 pointwise,只是名字不同
options_en: Their uses are fully interchangeable; pick any.
CE for CTR; BPR for candidate generation; LambdaRank for final re-ranking; LambdaMART for large-scale search ranking.
CE for re-ranking and LambdaRank for CTR — reversed from reality.
All four are pointwise, just different names.
optionExplanations: 它们粒度和目标不同,用途不可互换,混用会牺牲各自优势。
对;每个损失对应一个阶段/场景,粒度和载体决定它擅长哪一步。
角色说反了:CE 做 CTR/pointwise,LambdaRank 做 listwise 重排。
只有 CE 是 pointwise;BPR pairwise,Lambda 系是 listwise。
optionExplanations_en: They differ in granularity and goal, so uses aren't interchangeable and mixing sacrifices each one's strength.
Correct — each loss maps to a stage/scenario, with granularity and carrier setting what it's good at.
Roles reversed: CE is for CTR/pointwise and LambdaRank for listwise re-ranking.
Only CE is pointwise; BPR is pairwise and the Lambda family is listwise.

scenario: 面试官问"模型校准得好"到底是什么意思。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks what 'the model is well-calibrated' actually means.
q: 校准良好的定义是什么?
q_en: What is the definition of well-calibrated?
why: 校准良好=在所有模型输出 P=0.3 的曝光里,约 30% 真的发生了点击;即预测概率与实际频率一致。它和排序能力(AUC)是两回事:模型可以排序很好但概率系统性偏高/偏低。
why_en: Well-calibrated means among all impressions where the model says P=0.3, about 30% actually click — predicted probabilities match observed frequencies.
options: 模型的 AUC 越高就越校准,两者是一回事
在所有预测 P=0.3 的样本里约 30% 真的发生,即预测概率与实际频率一致
校准指模型准确率超过 90%
校准指模型对每个样本都输出 0 或 1 的确定预测
options_en: The higher the AUC the more calibrated; they're the same thing.
Among all samples predicted P=0.3, about 30% actually occur — predicted probabilities match observed frequencies.
Calibration means accuracy above 90%.
Calibration means the model outputs a definite 0 or 1 for every sample.
optionExplanations: AUC 只看排序,不看概率绝对值,高 AUC 也可能概率系统偏差、不校准。
对;校准是"预测概率=实际频率",与排序能力独立,竞价/阈值依赖它。
校准不是准确率,一个高准确率模型概率也可能不校准。
输出确定 0/1 反而丢了概率信息,与校准无关。
optionExplanations_en: AUC only measures ranking, not absolute probability; high AUC can still be systematically biased and miscalibrated.
Correct — calibration is 'predicted probability equals observed frequency', independent of ranking, relied on by bidding/thresholds.
Calibration isn't accuracy; a high-accuracy model can still be miscalibrated.
Outputting hard 0/1 discards probability information and is unrelated to calibration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率与真实频率一致的程度,说 0.3 就约 30% 会发生。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Calibration is how well predicted probabilities match true frequencies, so 0.3 means about 30% occur.

scenario: 广告竞价按 bid=P(click)×出价价值报价,模型的 P(click) 系统性偏高。
scenario_en: Ad bidding sets bid=P(click)×bid_value, and the model's P(click) is systematically inflated.
q: P(click) 校准偏差在二价拍卖里造成什么后果?
q_en: What does miscalibrated P(click) cause in a second-price auction?
why: 因为出价直接乘以 P(click):高估 P(click)→出价偏高→超支/多花钱;低估→出价偏低→丢掉本该赢的曝光、流失营收。所以竞价系统对校准的敏感度极高,光有高 AUC 不够。
why_en: Since bid multiplies by P(click), overestimation overbids and overspends while underestimation underbids and loses winnable impressions and revenue.
options: 没有后果,拍卖只看排序不看概率绝对值
高估 P(click)→超支多花钱,低估→丢曝光流失营收,竞价对校准极敏感
只会影响训练速度,不影响出价
会让模型 AUC 下降,但出价不受影响
options_en: No consequence; auctions only care about ranking, not absolute probability.
Overestimating P(click) overspends, underestimating loses impressions and revenue; bidding is highly calibration-sensitive.
It only affects training speed, not bids.
It lowers AUC but doesn't affect bids.
optionExplanations: 出价直接乘 P(click),概率绝对值错就出价错,不只是排序问题。
对;高估超支、低估丢量,是校准差在竞价里的直接金钱后果。
校准偏差影响的是出价金额,不是训练速度。
校准与 AUC 独立,偏差主要害的是出价而非 AUC。
optionExplanations_en: The bid multiplies by P(click), so wrong absolute probability means wrong bids, not just ranking.
Correct — overestimation overspends and underestimation loses volume, the direct monetary cost of poor calibration in bidding.
Calibration error affects bid amounts, not training speed.
Calibration is independent of AUC; the error mainly harms bids, not AUC.

scenario: 欺诈/医疗分诊用固定阈值(如 0.5)决定是否告警,模型对真实概率 0.4 的样本却输出 0.8。
scenario_en: Fraud/medical triage uses a fixed threshold (e.g. 0.5) to alert, but the model outputs 0.8 for a case whose true probability is 0.4.
q: 校准偏差在阈值决策里造成什么问题?
q_en: What problem does miscalibration cause in threshold-based decisions?
why: 阈值决策直接把概率和临界值比:真实 0.4 却报 0.8,会越过 0.5 阈值触发大量本不该有的告警(过多误报),挤占人工复核、侵蚀对系统的信任。这类系统必须概率校准,阈值才有意义。
why_en: Threshold decisions compare probability to a cutoff, so reporting 0.8 when true is 0.4 crosses the threshold and triggers excessive false alarms that erode trust.
options: 没影响,阈值决策不依赖概率数值
真实 0.4 报 0.8 会越过阈值,产生过多误报、挤占人工复核、侵蚀信任
只会让模型更保守,减少告警
会提升召回且没有任何副作用
options_en: No effect; threshold decisions don't depend on probability values.
Reporting 0.8 when true is 0.4 crosses the threshold, producing excessive false alarms that burden review and erode trust.
It only makes the model more conservative, reducing alerts.
It boosts recall with no downside.
optionExplanations: 阈值决策正是拿概率数值和临界值比,数值错决策就错。
对;高估越过阈值→误报暴增→人工复核过载、信任下降,这是阈值系统的校准代价。
高估是更激进而非保守,会增加而不是减少告警。
误报暴增有明显副作用(信任和人力),不是无副作用的召回提升。
optionExplanations_en: Threshold decisions compare the probability value to a cutoff, so a wrong value means a wrong decision.
Correct — overestimation crosses the threshold, spiking false alarms, overloading review and eroding trust, the calibration cost in threshold systems.
Overestimation is more aggressive, not conservative, increasing rather than reducing alerts.
A spike in false alarms has clear downsides (trust and labor), not a free recall boost.

scenario: 线上模型概率明显不校准,要排查常见成因。
scenario_en: A production model is clearly miscalibrated, and you must diagnose common causes.
q: 以下哪些是常见的概率不校准成因?(多选)
q_en: Which are common causes of miscalibration? (multiple)
why: 常见成因:重正则(把概率往中间压)、focal loss(重塑损失景观、牺牲校准换聚焦难例)、不均衡数据。CE 在均衡数据上开箱校准较好,但生产数据很少均衡。识别成因才能决定是否上后处理校准。
why_en: Common causes are heavy regularization, focal loss (reshapes the loss landscape), and imbalanced data.
options: 过重的正则化
focal loss(重塑损失景观,牺牲校准换聚焦难例)
类别不均衡的数据
使用了 GPU 而非 CPU 训练
options_en: Heavy regularization.
Focal loss (reshapes the loss landscape, trading calibration for hard-example focus).
Class-imbalanced data.
Training on GPU instead of CPU.
optionExplanations: 对;强正则把概率往中间压,削弱与真实频率的对应,导致不校准。
对;focal 为聚焦难例重塑损失,常以牺牲概率校准为代价。
对;不均衡数据让 CE 的开箱校准假设失效,概率系统性偏移。
错;GPU/CPU 只是硬件,不改变模型输出概率的校准性。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — heavy regularization squeezes probabilities toward the middle, weakening the match to true frequency.
Correct — focal reshapes the loss to focus on hard examples, often at the cost of calibration.
Correct — imbalanced data breaks CE's out-of-the-box calibration assumption, biasing probabilities.
Wrong — GPU vs CPU is just hardware and doesn't change output calibration.

scenario: 要量化模型校准程度,常见两个指标是 ECE 和 Brier score。
scenario_en: To quantify calibration, two common metrics are ECE and Brier score.
q: ECE 和 Brier score 各衡量什么?
q_en: What does each of ECE and Brier score measure?
why: ECE 把样本按预测概率分桶,取每桶 |预测−实际| 的加权平均,纯粹衡量校准误差;Brier score 是"概率 vs 0/1 结果"的均方误差,同时捕捉校准和区分度。ECE 专测校准,Brier 更综合。
why_en: ECE is the weighted average of per-bin |predicted-observed| measuring calibration only, while Brier score is the MSE of probability vs binary outcome capturing both calibration and discrimination.
options: 两者完全等价,数值总是相同
ECE=分桶 |预测−实际| 加权平均(纯校准);Brier=概率 vs 0/1 的 MSE(校准+区分度)
ECE 衡量区分度、Brier 只衡量校准,和实际相反
两者都只衡量 AUC,与校准无关
options_en: They're fully equivalent and always equal.
ECE is the weighted average of per-bin |predicted-observed| (calibration only); Brier is the MSE of probability vs 0/1 (calibration plus discrimination).
ECE measures discrimination and Brier only calibration — reversed from reality.
Both only measure AUC, unrelated to calibration.
optionExplanations: 两者衡量的侧重不同(纯校准 vs 校准+区分),数值也不同,不等价。
对;ECE 分桶纯测校准,Brier 用 MSE 综合校准与区分度,分工清楚。
角色说反了:ECE 专测校准,Brier 才兼顾区分度。
两者都直接关乎校准,不是只测 AUC。
optionExplanations_en: They emphasize different things (calibration only vs calibration plus discrimination) and differ numerically — not equivalent.
Correct — ECE bins to measure calibration purely, Brier uses MSE to capture both calibration and discrimination, a clean split.
Roles reversed: ECE measures calibration and Brier also captures discrimination.
Both directly concern calibration, not just AUC.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按预测概率分桶,各桶 |预测−实际| 的加权平均,衡量整体校准误差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ECE (Expected Calibration Error) bins by predicted probability and takes the weighted average of per-bin |predicted-observed|.

termDefinitions.meaning: 预测概率与 0/1 结果之间的均方误差,同时反映校准与区分度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Brier score is the mean squared error between predicted probability and the binary outcome, reflecting calibration and discrimination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 画预测概率 vs 实际频率,曲线在对角线下方=过度自信。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A reliability diagram plots predicted vs observed probability; a curve below the diagonal means overconfidence.

scenario: 模型不校准,验证数据有限,可靠性图大致呈 S 形(sigmoid 样),要选一个后处理校准方法。
scenario_en: The model is miscalibrated, validation data is limited, and the reliability diagram is roughly sigmoidal; pick a post-hoc calibration method.
q: 默认该用哪种后处理校准?
q_en: Which post-hoc calibration should be the default?
why: 用 Platt scaling:在 logit 上拟合一个两参数 logistic,P_cal=σ(a·z+b)。它假设可靠性曲线呈 sigmoid(多数神经网络输出成立),参数少、在有限验证数据上不易过拟合,是默认选择。数据有限时比非参的 isotonic 更稳。
why_en: Use Platt scaling: a 2-parameter logistic on the logit, which assumes a sigmoidal curve, resists overfitting on limited data, and is the default.
options: isotonic regression,非参最灵活,数据少也无所谓
Platt scaling:logit 上两参数 logistic,假设 sigmoid、少参不易过拟合,数据有限时默认
直接重训整个模型,不做后处理
把所有概率都乘 0.5,简单粗暴地压低
options_en: Isotonic regression — non-parametric and most flexible, and little data is fine.
Platt scaling: a 2-parameter logistic on the logit, assumes sigmoidal, few params resist overfitting, the default on limited data.
Just retrain the whole model, no post-hoc step.
Multiply all probabilities by 0.5 to bluntly lower them.
whenOtherWins: 当验证数据充足、且可靠性图明显非 sigmoid 时,才换非参的 isotonic regression 去拟合非 S 形模式。
optionExplanations: isotonic 非参更灵活但吃数据,验证数据有限时容易过拟合,不该做默认。
对;两参数、假设 sigmoid、抗过拟合,数据有限+曲线近 S 形时 Platt 是稳妥默认。
后处理校准就是为了不重训整模型,重训代价大且未必解决校准。
统一乘常数不是按可靠性曲线拟合,治不了系统性校准偏差。
optionExplanations_en: Isotonic is more flexible but data-hungry, prone to overfit on limited validation data — not the default.
Correct — two parameters, a sigmoidal assumption, and overfit resistance make Platt the safe default on limited, near-S-shaped data.
Post-hoc calibration exists to avoid retraining the whole model, which is costly and may not fix calibration.
Multiplying by a constant isn't fitting the reliability curve and won't fix systematic calibration bias.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后处理校准:在 logit 上拟合两参数 logistic P=σ(a·z+b),假设 sigmoid 曲线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Platt scaling is post-hoc calibration fitting a 2-parameter logistic P=sigmoid(a*z+b) on the logit, assuming a sigmoidal curve.

termDefinitions.meaning: 过 sigmoid 之前的原始分数 z,Platt scaling 直接在它上面做线性变换。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The logit is the raw pre-sigmoid score z, on which Platt scaling applies a linear transform.

scenario: 验证数据非常充足,可靠性图明显不是 S 形(有明显的非 sigmoid 弯折)。
scenario_en: Validation data is abundant, and the reliability diagram is clearly non-sigmoidal (with distinct non-sigmoid kinks).
q: 这种情况下该换哪种校准方法?
q_en: Which calibration method should you switch to here?
why: 换 isotonic regression:它是非参的单调阶梯函数,不假设分布,能拟合 Platt 的 sigmoid 假设抓不住的非 S 形模式。代价是需要大量验证数据才不过拟合——正好本场景数据充足,条件满足。
why_en: Switch to isotonic regression: a non-parametric monotonic step function that fits non-sigmoidal patterns Platt can't, given abundant validation data.
options: 坚持 Platt scaling,sigmoid 假设放哪都成立
isotonic regression:非参单调阶梯,拟合非 S 形模式,数据充足时可用
不校准,数据多就自动校准了
把 γ 调大用 focal loss 来顺便校准
options_en: Stick with Platt scaling; the sigmoidal assumption holds everywhere.
Isotonic regression: a non-parametric monotonic step function fitting non-sigmoidal patterns, usable given abundant data.
Don't calibrate; more data auto-calibrates.
Raise gamma with focal loss to calibrate along the way.
whenOtherWins: 若验证数据有限或曲线本就近 sigmoid,Platt scaling 更稳、不易过拟合,不该上 isotonic。
optionExplanations: 曲线明显非 S 形时,Platt 的 sigmoid 假设失配,拟合不好非线性弯折。
对;isotonic 非参能拟合非 sigmoid,且这里数据充足正好满足它的数据需求。
数据多不会自动校准,不均衡/正则等成因仍在,需显式后处理。
focal 是训练损失不是校准方法,调 γ 反而可能更不校准。
optionExplanations_en: When the curve is clearly non-sigmoidal, Platt's assumption is mismatched and fits the nonlinear kinks poorly.
Correct — non-parametric isotonic fits non-sigmoidal shapes, and abundant data here meets its data requirement.
More data doesn't auto-calibrate; causes like imbalance/regularization persist and need explicit post-hoc fixing.
Focal is a training loss, not a calibration method; raising gamma can worsen calibration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 非参的单调阶梯校准函数,不假设分布,能拟合非 sigmoid 形状但吃数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Isotonic regression is a non-parametric monotonic step calibration function that fits non-sigmoidal shapes but needs much data.

scenario: 回忆 focal loss 的公式与各因子作用。
scenario_en: Recall the focal loss formula and each factor's role.
q: 补全 focal loss 公式:
q_en: Fill in the focal loss formula:
text: L_focal = −α_t · {{(1−p_t)^γ}} · log(p_t);其中调制因子在 p_t→1 时趋近 {{0}},静默{{易分}}样本的梯度。
text_en: L_focal = −α_t · {{(1−p_t)^γ}} · log(p_t); the modulating factor approaches {{0}} as p_t to 1, silencing {{easy}}-example gradients.
why: α_t 平衡正负类权重,(1−p_t)^γ 是聚焦难例的调制因子:置信越高压得越狠,把梯度让给难样本。γ=0 时退化回普通交叉熵。
why_en: Alpha balances class weights and (1-p_t)^gamma focuses on hard examples, silencing confident ones, reverting to cross-entropy at gamma=0.

scenario: 线上 CTR 模型概率不校准,要走一遍诊断到修复再监控的完整流程。
scenario_en: A production CTR model is miscalibrated; walk the full diagnose-fix-monitor flow.
q: 把生产环境校准处理流程排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the production calibration workflow correctly:
steps: 用可靠性图/ECE 诊断:曲线在对角线下方=过度自信
在留出验证集上拟合后处理校准(默认 Platt scaling)
上线后持续监控 ECE,数据漂移时重拟合
在留出验证集上选方法:近 sigmoid+数据有限用 Platt,非 sigmoid+数据充足用 isotonic
why: 先用可靠性图/ECE 诊断偏差方向,再据曲线形状和数据量选方法(Platt vs isotonic),在留出集上拟合,最后上线持续监控 ECE、随漂移重拟合。"在验证集上做 Platt scaling 并线上监控 ECE"是资深级信号。
why_en: Diagnose with a reliability diagram/ECE, choose the method by curve shape and data, fit on a held-out split, then monitor ECE in production and refit on drift.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  D["诊断 ECE/可靠性图"] --> S["选方法"]
  S --> F["验证集拟合"]
  F --> M["线上监控 ECE"]

scenario: 两个 CTR 模型 AUC 相同,但一个概率校准、一个系统性高估,都要接进二价广告竞价。
scenario_en: Two CTR models share AUC, but one is calibrated and one systematically overestimates, both feeding a second-price ad auction.
q: 为什么"最大化 AUC"不足以保证竞价系统赚钱?
q_en: Why is maximizing AUC insufficient to make a bidding system profitable?
why: AUC 只看排序(谁点击概率更高),不看概率绝对值。竞价 bid=P(click)×价值直接吃概率绝对值,校准差的模型即使 AUC 一样也会扭曲出价、悄悄超支或丢量。所以竞价系统要显式盯校准(ECE),不能只优化 AUC。
why_en: AUC only measures ordering, but bidding uses absolute P(click), so an equally-ranked but miscalibrated model distorts bids and loses money.
options: AUC 已经包含校准信息,最大化 AUC 就够了
AUC 只看排序不看概率绝对值,竞价吃绝对值,校准差会扭曲出价、超支或丢量
两个模型 AUC 相同就一定同样赚钱
竞价只看排序,概率绝对值无关紧要
options_en: AUC already includes calibration, so maximizing AUC is enough.
AUC only measures ordering not absolute probability, but bidding uses the absolute value, so poor calibration distorts bids and overspends or loses volume.
Equal AUC guarantees equal profitability.
Bidding only looks at ranking; absolute probability is irrelevant.
optionExplanations: AUC 不含校准信息,排序一样但概率可系统偏移,AUC 看不出来。
对;竞价直接乘概率绝对值,AUC 相同校准不同就会一个赚钱一个亏,必须盯 ECE。
AUC 相同但校准不同,盈利能力可以差很多,不能只看 AUC。
竞价 bid=P(click)×价值,概率绝对值恰恰是关键,不是无关。
optionExplanations_en: AUC carries no calibration info; equal ranking can hide a systematic probability shift AUC can't see.
Correct — bidding multiplies by absolute probability, so equal AUC with different calibration makes one profitable and one not, requiring ECE monitoring.
Equal AUC with different calibration can differ greatly in profitability, so AUC alone isn't enough.
Bidding is bid=P(click)×value, so absolute probability is exactly what matters, not irrelevant.
